period_note: SOLO/SEPARATE basis (the 'Condensed Balance Sheet'/'Condensed Profit & Loss Account' columns headed 'Eastern Bank PLC.', as distinct from the 'Eastern Bank PLC. and its subsidiaries' Consolidated columns). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (column header '01 January 2025 to 30 September 2025', a 9-month cumulative figure), flagged via the _cumulative suffix. This filing also discloses a discrete 'July-September' column (not used for line_items, kept for context only): discrete Q3-only PAT was 2,402,876,301. Cross-checked the 31 December 2024 comparative column against bank_financials/EBL/quarterly/2024_Q4.json: total_assets (616,050,374,950 vs 616,050m), gross_loans (410,717,614,356 vs 410,718m), total_deposits (457,691,950,036 vs 457,692m), investments_securities (143,046,434,147 vs 143,046m), fixed_assets (6,318,911,387 vs 6,319m), borrowings (79,166,520,520 vs 79,167m), total_equity (43,063,636,095 vs 43,064m) — all match exactly, no discrepancy. No later filing yet exists with a Jan-Sep comparative column to check this quarter's EPS for a further bonus-share restatement (unlike Q1/Q2 2025, which were checked against the 2026 filings) — EPS here is the value as reported in this, the only report of this period.
